title: Positive solver tolerance gives only a tolerance-stamped compile guarantee
statement: A finite D solver that stops at a positive gain tolerance yields only a tolerance-stamped guarantee: the compiled nearest-centroid rule reproduces every training label except on rows whose relocation gain is at most that tolerance. Strictness of the argmin is not available in this regime, so prediction retains a deterministic tie-break and the guarantee is stamped with the tolerance that produced it.

proof_location.section: D6. Exact finite inductive closure / compiler

role: what a real solver can actually claim
